title: Money lending and crap games in Hampton's band
summary: Cobb says Duke handled loans at interest while Gladys stopped draws, so Cobb ran crap games and lent money too, lending Lamar Wright $20 in a game.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: No, he didn't think but everybody else did. And I was a victim of circumstances and didn't know how. And nobody told me anything different. But he come in to be a powerhouse in the band, even with Gladys. Gladys stopped
giving him his draws, and they were letting money out and let Duke handle it, $2.00 on 5.00. You borrowed $5.00, you had to pay $7.00 back. You borrow 20.00, you pay 28.00 back.
You didn't hear me good when I said (inaudible).

So I said, if she can do it, I can do it too. So I furnished the crap games, and I started to lending money and make the same thing she makes. But she couldn't go, because I'm not a draw man. I handled my own (inaudible). I want all of my salary at the end of the week. So they wasn't doing me no harm.

I said, now, these people with the money they got going to do this and lend money out to the band that's working there and making this man great? And won't give them a draw. They have to borrow money, and they send a man out to do it? I said, I'll do it too. And I did. I lent Lamar Wright $20.00 in a crap game, and he won 200.00 and paid me 28.00 back immediately, right likd that. Ain't that a fast turnover?
And they was getting it and splitting it up. Have you ever heard of anything like that?
Look, man, I don't mind saying it now, and if he get it, because they can't do me no harm, but this
is how you get to be a millionaire, huh?
Well, wasn't the band awful mad at that?
